the past 4 months despite a normal intake. ST also complains of foul-smelling stools 
and after several days of work-up, she is diagnosed with Crohn’s disease. Which of 
the following is the most likely cause of her weight loss?
a. Bowel obstruction
b. Malabsorption
c. Perforated colon
d. Vitamin deficiency
